chunks: 644 - What al-Husayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:
“When Ādam was sent down from al-Jannah, a black mark appeared upon him on his face from the top of him to his feet, so his sorrow and weeping over what had appeared on him became prolonged.
Then Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام came to him and said to him, ‘What makes you weep, O Ādam?’ He said, ‘Because of this mark that has appeared on me.’
He said, ‘Stand, O Ādam, and perform salat, for this is the time of the first prayer.’ So he stood and performed salat, and the mark descended to his neck.
Then he came to him at the second prayer and said, ‘Stand and perform salat, O Ādam, for this is the time of the second prayer.’ So he stood and performed salat, and the mark descended to his navel.
Then he came to him at the third prayer and said, ‘O Ādam, stand and perform salat, for this is the time of the third prayer.’ So he stood and performed salat, and the mark descended to his knees.
Then he came to him at the fourth prayer and said, ‘O Ādam, stand and perform salat, for this is the time of the fourth prayer.’ So he stood and performed salat, and the mark descended to his feet.

Then he came to him at the fifth prayer and said, ‘O Ādam, stand and perform salat, for this is the time of the fifth prayer.’ So he stood and performed salat, and when he came out of it, he praised Allah and extolled Him. Then Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام said, ‘O Ādam, the likeness of your offspring in these prayers is like your likeness regarding this mark. Whoever among your offspring performs five prayers in every day and night will come out of his sins just as you came out of this mark.’”

key_terms.آدَمُ: Adam عليه السلام, the first human and prophet mentioned in the narration
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the act through which purification occurred
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, from which Ādam عليه السلام was sent down
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام, the angel who instructed Ādam عليه السلام
key_terms.ذُنُوبِهِ: his sins, which are removed through the five daily prayers
key_terms.شَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ: a black mark, symbolizing the condition that was gradually removed
key_terms.وَقْتُ: appointed time, indicating the fixed times of the prayers

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain the wisdom behind the five daily prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that after Ādam عليه السلام was sent down from al-Jannah, a black mark upon him was gradually removed through the five daily prayers. Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام then explained that the five prayers similarly purify the children of Ādam from sins. The narration highlights the spiritual cleansing and divine wisdom in the five appointed prayers.
